title: Health and the doctor
scenario: You are in a patient role. Use English naturally in this health situation.

lines.text: Good morning. I have a terrible headache and a high fever.
I am sorry to hear that. How long have you had these symptoms?
The fever started two days ago and has not improved.
I see. I will write a prescription for you.
Should I describe any other symptoms?
Yes, do you have a sore throat or difficulty breathing?
No, just the headache and fever.
Please take the medicine after meals and rest completely.
